name: sv-formatter
description: Structure-driven SystemVerilog formatter: indentation derived from the parse tree, column alignment, macro-safe, and idempotent.

systemverilogFormatter.indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indentation level. Ignored when useTabs is true.

systemverilogFormatter.useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

systemverilogFormatter.explodePortList.description: Put each module port on its own line.

systemverilogFormatter.explodeDeclaratio.description: Put each declared signal on its own line, repeating the full type prefix (wire a, b; becomes two wire declarations).

systemverilogFormatter.explodeInstancePo.description: Put each instance port connection on its own line.

systemverilogFormatter.alignPortsInHeade.description: Align the direction, type, width and name columns of module ports and declarations.

systemverilogFormatter.alignDeclarationT.description: Align the trailing ; and , of consecutive declarations.

systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveA.description: Align the assignment operator of consecutive assignment statements.

systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveD.description: Align the declared names of consecutive declarations.

systemverilogFormatter.maxConsecutiveBla.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines to keep.

systemverilogFormatter.ensureTrailingNew.description: Ensure the file ends with exactly one newline.

systemverilogFormatter.formatOnParseErro.description: Format even when the source has syntax errors. Off by default to avoid mangling incomplete code.

systemverilogFormatter.trace.server.description: Trace formatting requests (for debugging the extension).
